entries.zh: 执兵摆出架势；持械就卫（上岗戒备）
entries.en: to take up one's guard; to take up arms on guard duty

entries.zh: 搅入纷扰（怒气正盛时掺和进去）；惑乱掺杂
entries.en: to entangle oneself in (a squabble) when anger runs high
entries.notes: 西语短语省略语境，'惑雜' pak-tsap 与'搅入怒乱'对当，具体用例存疑。

entries.zh: 侵占他人财产；插手他人产业
entries.en: to meddle in another's property; to encroach on another's estate

entries.zh: 擅自妄为、自作主张（摄自在）
entries.en: to act at will, take liberties; dispose as one pleases
entries.notes: source_L 栏文字残乱（'foso debaxo…la mesa'难以复原），释义依汉字'攝自在'与闽南语栏。

entries.zh: 塞进袖里；收入袖中（藏匿）
entries.en: to slip into the sleeve; to conceal in one's sleeve

entries.zh: 以袖携去；袖了就走（携物入袖带走）
entries.en: to carry off tucked in the sleeve; to slip away with it in the sleeve
entries.notes: 词头 'Canaga' 疑为闽南语 siù khù 的西文转写，其身份未能确证，释义依'袖去'。

entries.zh: 插话参议；在交易中凑一份意见、参与其事
entries.en: to put in one's opinion in the transaction; to have a say in the deal
entries.notes: [疑:合/凹] 字辨未定，按闽南语 kap-sū '合事（参与其事）'取义。

entries.en: to enter religion: become a friar or a bonze (monk)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕钻入鼻孔；强行闯入
entries.en: 〔uncertain〕to poke in through the nostril; to thrust oneself in obtrusively
entries.notes: source_L 栏 garbled（'narized o papel'不可解），[疑:空/孔]，'鉸'字与语义无法定夺。
[疑:胲/胠] 字辨未定，按闽南语 kue '脸颊'取'胲'。
[疑:胲/胠] 字辨未定，按闽南语 kue-kau-thâu '腮颊'取义。

entries.en: to mix in; to blend; to adulterate
entries.notes: [疑:摻/漆] 字辨未定，按闽南语 chám '掺和'取'摻'。

entries.en: to wet; to mix with water
entries.notes: M 栏多出 'humubo' 一段不可解（疑为旁注 húmedo 之类转写），按'濕 sip'义定夺。

entries.zh: 混合；掺合（并见'合 cab／juntarse'：会合、凑在一起）
entries.en: to mix; to join together (cf. cab, juntarse)

entries.zh: 混杂污秽之物；掺杂之物
entries.en: a thing mixed or soiled; a medley
entries.notes: [疑:桼/糞]：音读 bùn 合'糞'(pùn)，故取'污杂'义而非'漆'。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕混杂之物
entries.notes: '泳'字与西语'混合之物'不相应，音读 ōng 亦不合常例，语义无法定夺，依 L 栏照录。

entries.zh: 熔炼金属；合炼金属（冶金）
entries.en: to smelt or alloy metals; to refine
